title: Windows Credential Theft Protection — Credential Guard, LSASS Protection & Windows LAPS (Intune)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 - credential-theft defense (Credential Guard + LSASS PPL + WDigest + Remote Credential Guard + Windows LAPS) via Intune; resolves ~3 findings directly and hardens pass-the-hash posture.
Gap-only: no existing Credential Guard/LAPS product; WDigest overlaps the NTLM product but its primary home is here; RDP credential-delegation cross-referenced to the RDP hardening product.
Credential Guard requires TPM2.0/UEFI/Secure Boot/VBS - readiness assessment + phased rollout included; LSASS PPL audit-first.
White-label; Commercial-only this run; Gov price-only.
